greeting: The last day before twelve days at sea, Dan. The calendar's empty, so it's yours to pack, close the open Croatia bookings, and make the car call before it makes itself.

needsAttention.title: Make the Orlando-cycle car call
needsAttention.detail: Today is the Sept 7 decision point you set: if Mike's car isn't booked south with a written delivery window, keep the refundable TPA SUV and stop hedging. Deciding this from the boat next week goes badly.

needsAttention.title: Close the last Croatia bookings
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat night and the Sept 20-22 St. Pete landing gap both have to be booked from dry land -- charter connectivity is poor and you're wheels-up at 5:55 tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St. Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: This was due Sept 5, and the Oct 18-Nov 1 rental and Airbnb book while you're away. Make the call before Croatia, not from it.

flagged.title: Andrew Kaufmann reconnecting
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn InMail Saturday: he got a bounce, asked if you're still at KPMG, and would welcome picking the conversation back up.

flagged.title: Yvonne's LinkedIn message
flagged.detail: A new LinkedIn message landed this morning, waiting on your reply.

flagged.title: Portland Airbnb host waiting
flagged.detail: Damjan replied about the Sep 9-12 Old Port stay and is waiting on you -- worth clearing before you lose signal.

inbox.noise: The rest is receipts and alerts -- Square, ParkMobile, a Care.com applicant, a LinkedIn digest.

recipe.title: Quinces Poached in Muscat
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first quinces and late muscat grapes, a slow-poached pairing for the cooling evenings.

tasks.title: Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket
Contact the Nautilus instructor to confirm boarding
Buy EU plug adapters and a power strip

acts.line: The calendar's clear -- pack, and knock out the open Croatia bookings while you still have real internet.
Settle the car hedge and the Halloween call; both book themselves badly if left for the boat.
A quiet last night in St. Pete before tomorrow's 5:55 flight to Frankfurt -- bank the sleep.
